title: Hearing on flavored e-cigarette sales near schools
summary: The Council will examine a report finding flavored e-cigarettes widely available at licensed and unlicensed stores within 500 feet of New York City public middle and high schools, despite city and state bans. The report found illegal advertising, weak penalty collection from unlicensed stores, and no cases where the city had sealed a store solely for e-cigarette violations. The committees will also hear a bill letting the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection seal stores that repeatedly sell e-cigarettes illegally.
